## Product Categories

- [Pavement & Shopping Scooters](https://lifestylemobilityscooters.com.au/shop/mid-size-everyday/): Compact 4-wheel mobile scooters for sale. Best for shopping centres and daily use.
- [Heavy Duty Mobility Scooters](https://lifestylemobilityscooters.com.au/shop/heavy-duty-all-terrain/): Bariatric-ready large mobility scooters. High capacity and all-terrain performance.
- [Ramps & Vehicle Hoists](https://lifestylemobilityscooters.com.au/shop/ramps-hoists/): Technical solutions for loading your mobility cart or scooter.
- [Scooter Parts & Accessories](https://lifestylemobilityscooters.com.au/shop/batteries-accessories/): Replacement batteries, chargers, and custom mobility scooter accessories.
